import unittest
import os
from src.app_config import get_port
class TestEnv(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_env_port(self):
        os.environ['APP_PORT'] = '9090'
        self.assertEqual(get_port(), 9090)
        del os.environ['APP_PORT']
        self.assertEqual(get_port(), 8080)
if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

setup_files.tests/test_prom.py:
import unittest
from src.metrics_export import format_prometheus_counter
class TestProm(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_prom(self):
        out = format_prometheus_counter('http_requests_total', {'method': 'GET', 'code': '200'}, 42)
        self.assertTrue(out.startswith('http_requests_total{'))
        self.assertIn('method="GET"', out)
        self.assertIn('code="200"', out)
        self.assertTrue(out.endswith(' 42'))
if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
